age_calculation.name: Age
age_calculation.description: Calculates the subject's age in years at the time of the baseline visit.

body_mass_index.name: Body Mass Index (BMI)
body_mass_index.description: A measure of body fat based on height and weight that applies to adult men and women. Calculated as weight in kilograms divided by the square of height in meters.

body_surface_area_mosteller.name: Body Surface Area (Mosteller)
body_surface_area_mosteller.description: Calculates the Body Surface Area using the Mosteller formula. Used for indexing cardiac parameters.

mean_arterial_pressure.name: Mean Arterial Pressure (MAP)
mean_arterial_pressure.description: The average arterial pressure throughout one cardiac cycle, systole, and diastole.
mean_arterial_pressure.expression: MAP = Diastolic BP + (Systolic BP - Diastolic BP) / 3

ckd_epi_2021_egfr.name: eGFR (CKD-EPI 2021)
ckd_epi_2021_egfr.description: Estimates Glomerular Filtration Rate using the 2021 Chronic Kidney Disease Epidemiology Collaboration (CKD-EPI) equation. This is the current standard for eGFR calculation.
ckd_epi_2021_egfr.expression: 142 * min(Creatinine/κ, 1)^α * max(Creatinine/κ, 1)^-1.200 * 0.9938^Age * (1.012 if Female). Where κ is 0.7 for females and 0.9 for males, and α is -0.241 for females and -0.302 for males. Requires age calculation.

homa_ir.name: Homeostatic Model Assessment for Insulin Resistance (HOMA-IR)
homa_ir.description: A method used to quantify insulin resistance and beta-cell function from fasting glucose and insulin levels.

de_ritis_ratio.name: De Ritis Ratio (AST/ALT Ratio)
de_ritis_ratio.description: The ratio of Aspartate Aminotransferase (AST) to Alanine Aminotransferase (ALT). It can be used to help determine the cause of liver damage.

fib_4_score.name: Fibrosis-4 (FIB-4) Index
fib_4_score.description: A non-invasive score to estimate the degree of liver fibrosis in patients with chronic liver disease.

apri_score.name: APRI (AST to Platelet Ratio Index)
apri_score.description: A non-invasive marker for assessing liver fibrosis, calculated from AST and platelet count. Assumes an AST upper limit of normal (ULN) of 40 IU/L.

ejection_fraction_simpson.name: Ejection Fraction (Simpson's method)
ejection_fraction_simpson.description: Calculates the Left Ventricular Ejection Fraction, a key measure of cardiac systolic function.

stroke_volume_simpson.name: Stroke Volume (Simpson's method)
stroke_volume_simpson.description: Calculates the volume of blood pumped from the left ventricle per beat.

cardiac_output_simpson.name: Cardiac Output (by Simpson's)
cardiac_output_simpson.description: The volume of blood pumped by the heart per minute, calculated from stroke volume (by Simpson's method) and heart rate.

e_a_ratio.name: E/A Ratio
e_a_ratio.description: Ratio of early (E) to late (A) diastolic mitral inflow velocities, a measure of diastolic function.

e_e_prime_ratio_average.name: E/e' Ratio (Average)
e_e_prime_ratio_average.description: Ratio of early mitral inflow velocity (E) to the average of septal and lateral mitral annular early diastolic velocities (e'). A key indicator of left ventricular filling pressures.

left_atrial_volume_index.name: Left Atrial Volume Index (LAVI)
left_atrial_volume_index.description: Left atrial volume indexed to body surface area, a robust marker of diastolic dysfunction and cardiovascular risk.

left_ventricular_mass_devereux.name: Left Ventricular Mass (Devereux)
left_ventricular_mass_devereux.description: Calculates the mass of the left ventricle using the Devereux formula, an indicator of cardiac hypertrophy.

relative_wall_thickness.name: Relative Wall Thickness (RWT)
relative_wall_thickness.description: An echocardiographic measurement used to classify the pattern of left ventricular hypertrophy.

waist_to_hip_ratio.name: Waist-to-Hip Ratio (WHR)
waist_to_hip_ratio.description: A measure of body fat distribution and a predictor of health risk.

cha2ds2_vasc_score.name: CHA₂DS₂-VASc Score
cha2ds2_vasc_score.description: Estimates the risk of stroke in patients with non-valvular atrial fibrillation. Some components (e.g., prior stroke, vascular disease) are not in the provided variable list and would be assumed absent.
cha2ds2_vasc_score.expression: Points system: C(1), H(1), A₂(2), D(1), S₂(2), V(1), A(1), Sc(1).

has_bled_score.name: HAS-BLED Score
has_bled_score.description: Estimates the 1-year risk of major bleeding in patients with atrial fibrillation. Some components (e.g., bleeding history, labile INR) are not in the provided variable list and would be assumed absent.

chol_g_to_mmol.name: Unit Conversion: Cholesterol g/L to mmol/L
chol_g_to_mmol.description: Converts Total Cholesterol from grams per liter (g/L) to millimoles per liter (mmol/L).

hdl_g_to_mmol.name: Unit Conversion: HDL g/L to mmol/L
hdl_g_to_mmol.description: Converts HDL Cholesterol from grams per liter (g/L) to millimoles per liter (mmol/L).

ldl_g_to_mmol.name: Unit Conversion: LDL g/L to mmol/L
ldl_g_to_mmol.description: Converts LDL Cholesterol from grams per liter (g/L) to millimoles per liter (mmol/L).

trig_g_to_mmol.name: Unit Conversion: Triglycerides g/L to mmol/L
trig_g_to_mmol.description: Converts Triglycerides from grams per liter (g/L) to millimoles per liter (mmol/L).

body_surface_area_dubois.name: Body Surface Area (BSA) by Du Bois
body_surface_area_dubois.description: The total surface area of the human body, often used to index cardiac parameters. The Du Bois formula is a commonly used estimation.

waist_hip_ratio.name: Waist-to-Hip Ratio (WHR)
waist_hip_ratio.description: The ratio of the circumference of the waist to that of the hips. It is a measure of abdominal obesity.

pulse_pressure.name: Pulse Pressure (PP)
pulse_pressure.description: The difference between systolic and diastolic blood pressure, representing the force the heart generates each time it contracts.
pulse_pressure.expression: PP = Systolic blood pressure - Diastolic blood pressure

ckd_epi_egfr.name: Estimated Glomerular Filtration Rate (eGFR) by CKD-EPI
ckd_epi_egfr.description: Estimates GFR from serum creatinine, age, sex, and race. The CKD-EPI 2021 equation is the current standard.
ckd_epi_egfr.expression: A formula based on serum creatinine, age, and sex. e.g., 142 * min(Scr/κ, 1)^α * max(Scr/κ, 1)^-1.200 * 0.9938^Age * (1.012 if Female), where κ and α depend on sex and creatinine value.

non_hdl_cholesterol.name: Non-HDL Cholesterol
non_hdl_cholesterol.description: Calculates the total cholesterol minus HDL-C, representing all atherogenic lipoprotein particles.

triglyceride_hdl_ratio.name: Triglyceride to HDL Ratio
triglyceride_hdl_ratio.description: A marker of insulin resistance and atherogenic dyslipidemia.

ast_alt_ratio.name: AST/ALT Ratio (De Ritis Ratio)
ast_alt_ratio.description: The ratio of aspartate aminotransferase (AST) to alanine aminotransferase (ALT). It can be used to help determine the cause of liver damage.

stroke_volume_volumes.name: Stroke Volume (from Volumes)
stroke_volume_volumes.description: The volume of blood pumped from the left ventricle per beat, calculated as the difference between end-diastolic and end-systolic volumes.

stroke_volume_doppler.name: Stroke Volume (from Doppler)
stroke_volume_doppler.description: The volume of blood pumped from the left ventricle per beat, calculated using the LVOT diameter and VTI.

cardiac_index.name: Cardiac Index (CI)
cardiac_index.description: The cardiac output indexed to the body surface area, providing a more comparable measure across individuals of different sizes.

lv_mass_devereux.name: Left Ventricular Mass (Devereux Formula)
lv_mass_devereux.description: An estimation of the mass of the left ventricle using linear dimensions from an echocardiogram.

e_e_prime_ratio.name: E/e' Ratio
e_e_prime_ratio.description: A key echocardiographic parameter for assessing left ventricular diastolic function and estimating LV filling pressures. An average of septal and lateral e' is typically used.

estimated_pasp.name: Estimated Pulmonary Artery Systolic Pressure (PASP)
estimated_pasp.description: An estimation of the systolic pressure in the pulmonary artery using the simplified Bernoulli equation on the tricuspid regurgitation jet velocity.
estimated_pasp.expression: PASP (mmHg) = 4 * (TR Vmax (m/s))^2 + Estimated Right Atrial Pressure

average_gls.name: Average Global Longitudinal Strain (GLS)
average_gls.description: A measure of global left ventricular systolic function, calculated by averaging the GLS values from the 2, 3, and 4-chamber apical views.

average_gcs.name: Average Global Circumferential Strain (GCS)
average_gcs.description: A measure of left ventricular systolic function in the short-axis, calculated by averaging the GCS values from the basal, mid, and apical levels.

skeletal_muscle_index_calc.name: Skeletal Muscle Index (SMI) Calculation
skeletal_muscle_index_calc.description: A measure of muscle mass relative to height, used in the diagnosis of sarcopenia.

body_fat_percentage.name: Body Fat Percentage
body_fat_percentage.description: The percentage of total body mass that is composed of fat.
